We stayed for three nights in August at Paradise Gardens and were quite charmed by our choice. The apartments are just away from the main sea front area in this Turkish resort and everything you need from the village amenities are within easy reach. The apartments are fairly basic, but very clean and there was always plenty of hot water. We enjoyed just relaxing by the pool or sitting in the pleasant gardens. We agree with another review here that the owners did not speak very much English, but they were incredibly helpful and they were happy to assist in whatever way they could. They were constantly looking after their gardens and cleaning the poolside areas. We would certainly visit again for relaxation and a laid back holiday time.

Gumusluk is a little village with a beautiful bay 30 mins away from Bodrum. Even though Bodrum is a famous attraction for many travelers not as many people are aware of Gumusluk, a quiet nice town with some great fish restaurants, and little gift shops. I was there with my 8 month old son and wife recently and we picked Paradise Garden Apart to stay there, and that was a perfect pick , thanks to some friends who knew about this place. It is a little paradise with a nice garden a swimming pool . The most important is that it is a baby friendly place, Ayse Teyze , is a great help in finding fresh, organic food for your baby or kids. She will be happy to let you use her kitchen if you need to cook something special for your baby.. If you are traveling with your kids and if you happen to be in Gumusluk ,Paradise is your place. No hesitation in recommending it. It is 2 mins away from the Beach and the shore is lined with several small and big scale restaurants.
